Change Summary
This replaces a mathematically incorrect `head | tail` pipeline (which computed length as `end - start` instead of `end - start + 1`) with a direct `sed -n "${start},${end}p"` invocation. A guard for the degenerate `start > end` case is added to prevent undefined behavior in older or non-standard `sed` implementations that might otherwise echo the start address line.
